title: Asymptotic regularization method. A constructive approach
summary: We introduce a new regularization scheme for divergent integrals in quantum field theory. The framework is based on the structural decomposition of the integrand asymptotic expansion, which distinguishes between contributions that drive UV singularities and those that remain finite. This asymptotic regularization method isolates the genuinely singular sector and enables a consistent subtraction of divergences while maintaining covariance and gauge symmetry.
